data.name: Mythoria
data.detailed_description:
Mythoria – A Puzzle Adventure Through Shattered Realms

Deep beneath the earth lies Kreta, an ancient underground city where Minotaur's once guarded the secrets of a sacred labyrinth. For centuries, its halls protected forbidden knowledge and powerful artifacts… until a rare celestial alignment triggered an arcane catastrophe.
The labyrinth’s core exploded, tearing space and time apart. Runes of Passage were scattered across distant realms, and the Portals of Creation collapsed into chaos.

Think, observe, experiment — and find your way back to Kreta.

Play as a Minotaur

Play as Arkos, a young explorer destined to reclaim the wisdom of his ancestors.
But unlike the old legends of brute‑force Minotaur, your journey demands something far more powerful: your mind.

Resolve Over 60 Challenging Puzzles

Challenge your logic and creativity across four unique environments. Each area introduces new mechanics, new twists, and new ways to think.

Manipulate Ancient Mechanisms

Use ballista and arrows, direct beams of light with vibrant flowers, move rocks linked to natural forces, and outsmart the shifting architecture of the labyrinth itself.

Explore Four Distinct Realms

Travel through:

  • The Dwarves Mines carved deep beneath the mountains

  • Floating Ancient Temples suspended in the sky

  • The Lost Civilization’s Ruined Sanctuary

  • The Legendary Labyrinth where it all began

Every realm features its own puzzle logic, atmosphere, and challenges

Recover the Shattered Runes

Search each world for fragments of the Runes of Passage, forge them back together, and reactivate the ancient portals that lead you closer to Kreta.

A Stress‑Free Puzzle Adventure

There are no death mechanics or harsh penalties in Mythoria. Take your time, try ideas freely, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving puzzles without fear of setbacks. The world is built for curiosity — experiment, explore, and let your mind wander at its own pace.
